title: SpendWise: Expense Tracker
short_description: Offline expense tracker. Scan bills, no login, data stays on your phone.
full_description:
SpendWise is a simple expense tracker that works fully offline. Scan a bill, tag it, and see where your money goes each month.

- Offline-first: no login, no cloud required
- Scan bills with your camera
- Monthly budgets and clear charts

Your data stays on your phone. Install and take control of your spending today.
whats_new: Faster bill scanning and a refreshed budget screen.
